description: Increase in width of existing vehicular access to the site, partial removal of existing boundary fence to enable a wider gate to be installed.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Before any works commence on site, a revised design, showing both the alterations to the access and the reconstruction of the footway from the access up to the site's northern boundary, in materials and at a level to match the adjoining section of footway, shall have been submitted to and approved by Local Planning Authority. The approved designs shall be implemented in their entirety, prior to the amended access coming in to use
